FN-TATX151-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 140
Committee: Urban and Rural Development Sponsor: Representative Arnold Mooney
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 02/12/2025
House Bill 140 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Public Service Commission
by an undetermined amount dependent on the cost to regulate certain private sewer or
wastewater systems that elects to come under the jurisdiction of the commission. These
obligations could be offset, in whole or in part, by the collection of certain existing regulatory
fees.
